poll_comparison.reading: a plain write answers as soon as the device has the data; FUA and flush both take about six times as long because the device is committing before it answers

read_path: Android's own UFS driver, after a reboot

two_mistakes.why: XNU's _IO is IOC_VOID | group | num and IOC_VOID is 0x20000000, so the number user space must pass is not the small one it looks like

two_mistakes.what: PRDT entry count of 1 on a command that moves no data
two_mistakes.why: utrd[7] packs prd_table_length in the low half, in entries not bytes; 0x00000001 says one entry at offset 0
two_mistakes.fix: 0x01000000 -- zero entries at the usual offset
two_mistakes.note: codex had warned not to reuse the data description; the host test also carried the wrong value in an assertion and caught the correction
